subject: CFRunLoopActivity

observation.summary: CoreFoundation ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 (/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation is a broken symlink); its image is resident in the arm64e dyld shared cache (sha256 ecc822c56dbce82d0f151afd7bf8492e91b109944483614f0eaaf377ac7d21da), so otool-exports and nm-symbols both return status=tool-failed against this path. dyld_info resolves the canonical path through the cache and reads the image's LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE directly. source_artifact is the verbatim dyld_info export dump captured to the cache directory, which is the observed artifact. CFRunLoopActivity is an enum type and emits no symbol; the enum values (kCFRunLoopEntry, kCFRunLoopBeforeTimers, ...) likewise do not appear in the export trie. The observer callback signature that consumes it is declared in the upstream mirror.
observation.raw_output_excerpt: (no CFRunLoopActivity / kCFRunLoop* enum symbol in the export trie)

claim: CFRunLoopActivity is a CF_OPTIONS(CFOptionFlags, ...) bitmask enum delivered to the CFRunLoopObserverCallBack callback; it is a compile-time type with no Mach-O symbol, so its bit layout is defined only by the upstream headers and cannot be observed from the export table.
